description: Run one prompt through a live AI engine (ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity, Copilot or Google AI Mode) from a country and return the full answer, the pages it cited and, if a brand is given, whether and where it was named. Costs one engine check from the workspace budget. (Requires an AIReady API key.)

competitors.description: Optional competitor names to rank against

domain.description: Optional brand domain, to detect citations of its site

prompt.description: The question exactly as a buyer would type it

name: ask_ai_engine
title: Ask an AI engine (live)
